business.headline: Buying gold jewellery or luxury bag as investment? Radhika Gupta has a warningRadhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, separated what she called physical investments from financial investments, and urged investors to think about how easily an asset can actually be converted into money when they need it.

Don't buy crypto in India: Radhika Gupta's blunt advice to investorsAt the India Today Woman Summit 2026, Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, told investors not to buy crypto in India. She said the concern was less about the asset and more about weak regulatory, tax and investor recourse safeguards.

Cracks, questions and a changing guard at TataThe Tata name has spent more than a century building an empire that touches almost every part of Indian life. But as the group prepares for a change at the top, several of its biggest businesses are demanding very different things at the same time.

Rs 5 crore, Rs 10 crore or Rs 40 crore: How much is enough to retire?Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, said people should stop fixating on a Rs 40 crore retirement target. She said retirement planning should begin with projected expenses and disciplined investing, not intimidating headline numbers.

Radhika Gupta 10-30-50 rule for women: How much to invest in your 20s, 30s, 40sRadhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, outlined a 10-30-50 investing rule for women at the India Today Woman Summit 2026. She said automatic SIPs, basic protection and simple diversification matter more than chasing complexity.

Economic regulations worse than 1991, no Manmohan Singh to bail us out: ChidambaramFormer finance minister P Chidambaram criticised India's current economic model, saying regulations were worse than in 1991 and the country lacked an economic brain like Manmohan Singh. He questioned the manufacturing push, limited FTAs and shrinking competition, while calling for stronger domestic manufacturing and a more competitive economy.

India receives Rs 4,895 crore FDI after easing rules for neighbouring countriesThe government said the investments cover sectors such as information technology, artificial intelligence, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, data centres and transport services.

Sugar gets costlier ahead of festivals: Govt rules out ethanol as the reasonAccording to government data, the price of sugar increased from Rs 48.18 per kg on July 20, 2026, to Rs 55.70 per kg on August 20.

The next UPI innovation won't be faster payments, it will be safer paymentsAs fraudsters become more sophisticated, industry experts believe the next phase of UPI's growth will be built around trust, smarter fraud detection and security that works quietly in the background.

India plans $1.2 billion manufacturing push to reduce China machinery dependenceIndia is finalising a $1.2 billion incentive scheme to spur local production of tunnel boring machines and other construction equipment, aimed at reducing supply risks linked to China while supporting the country's infrastructure build-out.

SBI cash withdrawals to cost more from October 1: What customers need to knowSBI has revised cash withdrawal charges for eligible BSBD accounts opened through branches from October 1, 2026. The change keeps four monthly withdrawals free but raises costs for customers who rely on cash more often.

Housing prices rise 6% in India: Check cities which saw the sharpest riseHousing prices across India rose 6% year-on-year in 1QFY27, with Bengaluru and Hyderabad leading the increase. A report underlines how stronger demand, better connectivity and premium housing are pushing up values even as sales volumes grow modestly.

Cognizant alerts customers over data breach, offers $1 million identity theft coverThe company has asked affected customers to consider filing a police report and placing a security freeze on their credit reports.

Sensex ends flat as financial stocks offset crude and bond yield concernsThe BSE Sensex ended at 77,540.83, up 3.11 points, or 0.004%, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,252.00, up just 20 points at the closing bell.

Has India lost the AI race? NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant answersFormer NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant said India has not lost the AI race and can build strength through talent and data centres. He said the bigger opportunity lies in applying AI across sectors while reshaping skilling for future jobs.

LIC gets green light from RBI to raise HDFC Bank stake to nearly 10%The Reserve Bank of India has allowed LIC to raise its HDFC Bank stake up to 9.99%. The approval gives LIC the room to buy more shares.

Why every fintech needs a fraud strategy before a growth strategyFor fintechs, growth is exciting, but it can also attract a growing fraud problem. As scams become smarter, companies need to build strong fraud defences before they chase the next wave of customers.

Tata Sons succession search moves into action, meetings begin to find next chiefTata Trusts chairman Noel Tata met former HDFC chairman Deepak Parekh in Mumbai as Tata Trusts begin shaping the committee to pick Tata Sons' next chairman. The move sets the succession process in motion after N Chandrasekaran decided not to seek another term.
Gold, silver jump over 5% this week: Is it still the right time to buy?With gold and silver climbing this week, investors face a tough call: chase the rally, hold their positions or cash out?

When does EPF stop earning interest? EPFO explains rules for inoperative accountsAn old EPF account should not be forgotten just because you have moved to a new job. Knowing its status can help you keep track of your retirement savings and avoid problems when you eventually want to access the money.

entertainment.headline: Sasti copy is out: Kangana Ranaut slams Taapsee Pannu over 'upbringing' remark Actor Taapsee Pannu recently stated that she has never met actor-politician Kangana Ranaut despite their public history. The comments drew a sharp social media response from Kangana, reigniting their long-standing 'sasti copy' feud.

Deepika Padukone 'would never collaborate' with Sandeep Reddy Vanga, claims source Fresh claims surrounding actor Deepika Padukone's meeting with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga have brought her Spirit exit back into the spotlight. The new revelations reignite a long-running row over her departure from the film.

Govinda visits Juhu hospital amid feud with Ssunita Ahuja, addresses health concern Actor Govinda was seen outside a Juhu hospital amid his public dispute with Ssunita Ahuja and renewed attention on their marriage. The actor interacted with the paparazzi, who asked him about his health as he exited.

You drive me crazy, Kareena Kapoor tells paps, laughs off pregnancy rumours Actor Kareena Kapoor appeared to brush aside pregnancy rumours sparked by a gym video that surfaced online. Her humorous social media post came after denial from her sister-in-law Saba Pataudi amid the viral claims.

Kareena, Dhanush set to feature in Bhansali's mythological film? Director responds Director PS Mithran said talks are underway for a Sanjay Leela Bhansali-backed film with Kareena Kapoor Khan and Dhanush. The reported project could mark multiple firsts, including Mithran's Hindi directorial debut and Kareena's first collaboration with Bhansali since Devdas.

Abhishek Malhan on Munawar Faruqui rivalry in The Traitors 2: He made it about ego According to YouTuber Abhishek Malhan, his The Traitors 2 clash with stand-up comedian Munawar Faruqui ended with the game, though the social media fallout ultimately turned into an ego issue.

Priyanka Chopra says she wouldn't have loved Nick without respect for Indian culture Actor Priyanka Chopra said she might not have loved husband Nick Jonas if he had not respected her Indian culture and traditions. She said mutual respect for a partner's roots is vital in any multicultural relationship.

Taapsee Pannu addresses Kangana Ranaut feud, rules out joining politics At the India Today Woman Summit 2026, Taapsee Pannu said she never met Kangana Ranaut despite years of public friction. She also said politics is not for her, linking her public views to what she was taught as a student.

My glamour causing jealousy: Mallika Sherawat on Shalini Passi's fake dress claims Addressing the ongoing row over her green dress on The Traitors Season 2, actor Mallika Sherawat dismissed Shalini Passi's authenticity claims, attributing the debate to jealousy about her figure and glamour.

Live and let live: Saba Pataudi shuts down Kareena Kapoor pregnancy rumours Saba Pataudi dismissed rumours about Kareena Kapoor's pregnancy, calling the viral clip a bad angle. Her clarification, backed by Kareena's team, pushed back against speculation over a private matter.

Govinda's niece Arti Singh reacts to his marriage controversy with Ssunita Ahuja Arti Singh said she would speak to Sunita Ahuja privately and not comment publicly on the family matter. Her response came as discussion continued over Sunita withdrawing her divorce petition against Govinda.

Chiranjeevi's next titled Kaaka, first glimpse teases two distinct shades of actor Chiranjeevi marked his birthday with the title glimpse of Kaaka, unveiling him as K Satyam and a younger alter ego. The teaser sets up a dual-avatar entertainer and fixes its Sankranthi release.

Conan O'Brien tries to crack Bollywood, leaves Ali Fazal-Richa Chadha stunned Conan O'Brien tried to convince Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal that he could be a Bollywood star. His claim that he could not speak Hindi but could "sing Hindi" became the promo's standout gag.

Michael Wright, The Five Heartbeats actor, dies at 70 Michael Wright, best known as Eddie King Jr in The Five Heartbeats, has died at 70. His death marks the loss of an actor remembered for Eddie King Jr and a career across film and television.

Deepika Padukone likes post defending her Spirit exit and 10% profit share Deepika Padukone liked an Instagram post that criticised claims around her exit from Spirit. The reaction has revived debate over profit sharing, work hours and how women actors are judged.

Who was Yash before KGF? The question that misses the bigger story For those wondering about Yash, long before KGF, he had spent a decade building his star power – from theatre and television to Kannada cinema. KGF didn't make the star; it simply made him impossible for the rest of India to miss.

Batwara 1947 box office Day 8: Sunny Deol film hits new low, misses Rs 50-crore mark Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 earned Rs 75 lakh nett on Day 8. The result leaves the film chasing Rs 50 crore gross worldwide in its second weekend amid competition from Awarapan 2.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 8: Emraan Hashmi film nears Rs 170 crore worldwide Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 continues its successful run at the box office, earning Rs 119 crore nett in India within eight days and nearing Rs 170 crore worldwide. The sequel to the 2007 hit has maintained steady audience interest.

Awarapan 3 on cards? Writer Bilal Siddiqui says there is no story yet Bilal Siddiqui said the ending of Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 left room for Shivam's journey to continue. He highlighted that Awarapan 3 had no story yet. The writer also discussed fan expectations and the sequel's connection with Gen Z.

general news.headline: We got attacked: Carney says Canada at war with US over Trump's 50% tariffsCanadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced "dollar-for-dollar" retaliatory tariffs on American goods from September 8 after US President Donald Trump imposed 50 per cent levies on around USD 20 billion worth of Canadian goods, saying, "You're at war when you're attacked, and we got attacked."

Reservation not charity: Chirag Paswan amid anti-quota protest at Jantar MantarChirag Paswan said at Patna airport that reservations cannot be abolished on demand. He said it remains a constitutional tool for social justice and should be explained through dialogue.

Trump shares Hormuz image as 'US territory' as Iran faces new sanctionsUS President Donald Trump again shared an image calling the Strait of Hormuz "US territory" as Iran warned against Washington's economic pressure. Tehran condemned proposed fresh US sanctions, while tensions over the strategically vital waterway and Iran's oil trade continued to escalate.

23 injured as 5.9-magnitude quake rattles eastern Japan, tremors felt in TokyoA magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck eastern Japan early Sunday, injuring at least 23 people, disrupting trains and causing blackouts in Tokyo. No tsunami threat was reported, while power was later restored and nuclear facilities reported no anomalies.

The latents in Samay Raina's show who remained latentThey were counting on a few minutes on Samay Raina's India's Got Latent to boost their following and earnings. The episode got recorded but was never aired after the Ranveer Allahbadia controversy last year. We spoke to two such participants whose episodes never aired, and who, like a dozen participants with them, remained latent.

Tehseen Poonawalla under house arrest before E20 protest, offers cops sugarcane juiceActivist Tehseen Poonawalla claimed he was put under house arrest by the Delhi Police as he tried to leave home for a Jantar Mantar protest against sugar prices and the E20 policy. He posted a video of the confrontation on his social media, claiming that he was being denied the right to protest over sugar and ethanol policies.

Sticks, slippers, buckets fly as Northeast students, locals clash at Andhra collegeA missing mobile phone dispute at SK College of Nursing in Kakinada escalated into a confrontation between Northeast and local students. Officials intervened, shifted students to separate accommodation and said the situation was brought under control.

Keep politics out, teachers' body says after CJP team's school visit in RajasthanThe Akhil Bharatiya Rashtriya Shaikshik Mahasangh said it strictly stands against the politicisation of schools in the state after the CJP team's visit.

They spy on India from space. Now an Indian startup is ready to expose themDigantara is developing MOSAIC, an autonomous system to detect and track objects moving above India. The effort reflects a wider push to build independent space awareness as satellite activity grows.

22 missing after cargo ship sinks off Odisha coast, Navy joins rescue opsA Panama-flagged bulk carrier carrying 24 crew members sank in the Bay of Bengal off Odisha. Two survivors have been rescued, while the Indian Coast Guard and Navy continue searching for 22 missing crew members.

Swine flu spike in Delhi: Govt urges masks, avoid crowds, seek medical helpDelhi has issued a public health advisory as H1N1 and other influenza cases climb across the city. The move comes as authorities tighten surveillance, hospital readiness and public precautions during the seasonal surge.

2 dead, 5 injured as Ganesh idol falls during arrival ceremony in MumbaiIn Mumbai, idol arrival ceremonies have become a major part of the celebrations, with large processions accompanying idols to neighbourhood pandals. These events typically feature music, decorations and large gatherings of devotees.

Call me, I'll join your protest: Rahul Gandhi offers to join tribal students' stirAt an interaction in Pune, Rahul Gandhi told tribal students he was ready to join their protest. The exchange spotlighted demands on hostels, school facilities, healthcare and student safety.

Meet the IIT Bombay engineer who turned down ISRO to build Rs 1,000 crore AtombergIIT Bombay alumnus Manoj Meena had an ISRO job waiting after graduation. Instead, he chose entrepreneurship and spent four years searching for a scalable idea. A breakthrough in energy-efficient motors eventually led to Atomberg, which crossed Rs 1,000 crore in total income in FY25.

Dipke should stay away from schools, but keep talking about themAbhijeet Dipke and his CJP are highlighting the poor condition of government schools. But barging into classrooms risks putting schoolchildren in the crosshairs. The activists should keep raising the issues and force officials to act without turning schools into sites of confrontations.

PM Modi pushes social media outreach with new BJP office-bearersPM Narendra Modi met the BJP's newly appointed national office-bearers and urged them to stay active on social media. The emphasis came as the party prepared to expand youth outreach and review election strategy.

Deepinder Goyal says Temple is the smallest wearable, launching by end of 2026Deepinder Goyal's Temple wearable is now less than half the size of its earlier version, with limited-edition pre-orders opening soon. The brain-tracking device is expected to start shipping before the end of 2026.

Chinese robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m record in stunning Beijing sprintChinese humanoid robot Tiangong Ultra stunned at the World Humanoid Robot Games, completing 100 metres in 9.39 seconds, faster than Usain Bolt's 9.58-second world record. The performance highlights rapid advances in robotics and China's growing ambitions in the humanoid robot industry.

The recognition gives him inheritance rights to Laurent's private wealth but no royal allowance, duties or claim to the throne.

Dollar for dollar: Carney draws tariff battle lines after Canada-US talks collapseCanada's tariff retaliation risks a wider trade war and could permanently reshape its decades-old economic relationship with the US.

sports.headline: Gianni Infantino's FIFA rift deepens after defying vice president's request Gianni Infantino attended a Caribbean youth tournament despite Victor Montagliani asking him to stay away. The visit has sharpened a wider FIFA governance dispute over the shelved investor plan and his leadership.

Kujur, Gurindervir humbled at home before Asian Games. And that is a good thing Animesh Kujur and Gurindervir Singh were humbled at home in Bhubaneswar, but their defeat could prove to be exactly what they needed before the Asian Games. For India's leading sprinters, the Continental Tour in Bhubaneshwar, was in some ways, the perfect preparation they needed.

Australia vs Bangladesh, 2nd Test Day 2: Live Score and Updates from Mackay AUS vs BAN, 2nd Test Day 2 Live Score and Updates: Australia are in a commanding position in the Mackay Test, having already secured a 101-run lead. Bangladesh, meanwhile, will look to wrap up the remaining two wickets quickly before aiming for a stronger batting performance in the second innings.

Carlos Alcaraz, Serena Williams form dream team for US Open mixed doubles Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz will form a blockbuster mixed doubles partnership at the 2026 US Open after receiving a wild card. While Alcaraz prepares to defend his singles title, Williams' participation in the singles draw remains uncertain.

Premier League: Disjointed Manchester United humbled by spirited Hull City Hull City beat Manchester United 2-0 at the MKM Stadium after exposing repeated defensive lapses. The result leaves Michael Carrick with early questions over tempo, balance and defensive recruitment.

BWF Worlds: Gayatri,Treesa win bronze after a scare to World No. 1Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly pushed the World No.1 pairing of Liu Sheng Shu and Tan Ning with a stunning performance, but were ultimately beaten on Saturday, August 22. After Gambhir's gospel, India eye first overseas series win of his tenure in ColomboSL vs IND 2nd Test: After Gautam Gambhir's outspoken press conference, India head into the final Test against Sri Lanka with a chance to secure their first overseas series win of his tenure and offer a glimpse of progress in their rebuilding phase.

Marcus Rashford's Manchester United 2nd innings: Forward gets new jersey numberManchester United have officially registered Marcus Rashford as their new No.9 after his return. The move keeps him in the first-team picture even as his long-term future remains unclear.

Asian Games bound wrestler Mukul Dahiya provisionally suspended by NADAIndia's Asian Games wrestling campaign has suffered a major setback with Mukul Dahiya provisionally suspended by NADA. The 86kg medal contender tested positive for Mephentermine just weeks before the Games in Japan.

My job is to win trophies, not likes and views: Gautam GambhirGautam Gambhir believes India are not as poor in Test cricket as recent results suggest, viewing their struggles as temporary blips during a team in transition.

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi can give Test cricket an exciting future: Rahul DravidRahul Dravid believes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's red-ball development could have a major impact on Test cricket's future, urging patience with the 15-year-old as he prepares to play for East Zone in the Duleep Trophy.

Cristiano Ronaldo kickstarts probable final season with 977th career goalCristiano Ronaldo has begun what could be his final season with another landmark goal. The 41-year-old scored his 977th career goal for Al Nassr, leaving him just 23 short of the historic 1,000 mark.
